product_name: Bajaj Life Group Sampoorna Suraksha Kavach
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Single/Regular Premium Life Group Pure Risk Premium Insurance Plan
variants: Variant 2 — Death Benefit plus Accelerated Accidental Permanent Total Disability Benefit
Variant 3 — Death Benefit plus Accelerated Critical Illness Benefit
Variant 4 — Death Benefit plus Accelerated APTD plus Accelerated Critical Illness Benefit
key_benefits: Group credit-life / micro-loan protection plan: covers the outstanding loan liability of members of a group (Financial Institutions, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, etc.).
Master policyholder is the lending institution; the borrowers are the covered members.

Sum Assured paid on the first covered event (Death, or — per variant — Accidental Permanent Total Disability or first-diagnosed Critical Illness); all risk cover terminates for that member after the claim.
Choice of Level or Reducing cover (reducing follows the loan schedule of insurance).
Single or Regular premium; Joint Life option available (member & spouse — benefit on first event of either life).
Benefit above the outstanding loan balance is paid to the member's nominee.
No maturity benefit. Accelerated CI/APTD benefits are subject to pre-existing-condition (48-month) and other exclusions.

eligibility.policy_term: 6 months to 120 months (each member's policy term equals the outstanding loan tenure)
eligibility.note: An Eligibility-Conditions table exists in the brochure but its numeric age / sum-assured / premium values are not captured in the parse. Verify against the policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: Free-look period is not stated in the captured sections of this group brochure — verify against the policy document.
key_terms.grace_period: Grace period applies (member's cover ceases if premium not received within grace); the day-count is not stated numerically in the captured sections.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not separately stated as a 12-month clause in the captured sections; group credit plan. Verify against the policy document.
key_terms.surrender_value: Master policyholder may surrender anytime. Member surrender value: NONE under Regular Premium Level Cover; under Regular Premium Reducing Cover, payable only after the premium-paying term (higher of SSV and GSV); under Single Premium, anytime (higher of SSV and GSV). GSV = GSV factor x premium paid.
key_terms.revival_note: Member cover revivable within 5 years of first unpaid premium (and before end of PPT), subject to underwriting.
key_terms.pre_existing_note: Accelerated Critical Illness and APTD benefits exclude pre-existing conditions (signs/symptoms/diagnosis/treatment within 48 months prior to commencement or latest revival), in line with Health Insurance Regulations, 2016. CI not payable if symptoms occurred within 180 days of commencement/revival.
key_terms.tax_note: Premium, other benefits and Death Benefit 'may be eligible for tax benefits as per extant Income Tax Act' — consult a tax consultant; GST per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: Coverage scope is variant-bound: APTD cover only under Variants 2 & 4; Critical Illness cover only under Variants 3 & 4 — any 'covers disability / critical illness' claim must name the applicable variant.
It is a credit-protection plan tied to a loan — any 'pays your family' claim must reflect that the benefit first clears the outstanding loan and only the excess goes to the member's nominee.
Sum Assured may be Level or Reducing — a 'full sum assured paid' claim must state the chosen cover type (reducing cover decreases per the loan schedule).
Accelerated CI/APTD benefits are subject to pre-existing-condition (48-month) and CI 180-day waiting exclusions — must be stated, not implied as immediate full cover.
Surrender value availability is option-specific (none for Regular Level cover) and must be stated accurately.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings/investment or maturity product — it is a non-linked, non-participating group pure risk plan with NO maturity benefit.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns', 'maturity', 'money back' or 'bonus' language.
Do NOT imply the full sum assured is always paid to the family — for reducing cover it tracks the declining loan, and the loan is settled first.
Do NOT present CI/APTD cover as unconditional — pre-existing conditions and waiting periods exclude early claims.
Do NOT market member-level benefits without identifying the variant that provides them.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Single/Regular Premium Life Group Pure Risk Premium Insurance Plan'
That it is a group credit-life plan with no maturity benefit; benefit first covers the outstanding loan.
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms, conditions and exclusions (including pre-existing-condition exclusions).
